A separate Hermite-basis Gram-Schur computation in CHECK.py reproduces both closed forms for nine values of s, including endpoints; finite numerical experiments are corroborative only. The time-first/frequency-first order and both boundary values are explicit.

originality.rationale: Full structural claim compares two distinct directional small-separation limits of an unsigned zero-pair factorial density under a real Hermite mixture. The 2022 general results give one-point intensities and radial signed-pair expressions, while 2026 pure-Hermite results focus on rotation invariant windows. Exact contact formulas require a separate nonradial two-point Kac–Rice regression with second derivatives, and the different cubic/quartic onset exponents are not implied by the prior one-point formulas. value.rationale: Mixed Gaussian–Hermite windows interpolate between analytic Gaussian zeros (complete zero repulsion) and first-Hermite polyanalytic zeros (positive zero-pair contact). The exact anisotropic contact law reveals different cubic and quartic exponents in physically orthogonal directions as the Hermite contamination vanishes, with a diverging directional ratio 4/(3s). This is a motivated local clustering invariant and sharp structural transition, not a one-point intensity restatement or arbitrary finite tabulation.
